annotations.title: asksteps: switch a process on or pause it (needs the account's mandate)

description: Switches a process on (active = true) or pauses it (active = false). Requires "automation:write". Both directions need the account's mandate "activate" (granted by the account owner in the studio under AI agents) and work in three steps: without the mandate the answer is "confirmation_required" with the studio link and NOTHING happens — hand the user the url; with the mandate and without confirm the answer is "input_required" with the findings and what the switch does — read it to the user and ask; only with confirm = true it is carried out, and the account owner is emailed about it. Switching on makes the process start for every new submission and lets email reach visitors; pausing stops new cases but running cases keep going. "invalid" lists the checks that failed.

active.description: true to switch on, false to pause.

confirm.description: Set to true only AFTER the user has explicitly agreed. Without it nothing is switched.

name: asksteps_set_process_active

issues.description: The findings that block (or would block) switching on, with path and code.

path.description: Where the problem is, for example "parts[2].settings.templateId", "edges[0].condition" or "durationMinutes". Indices count in the list you sent.

shortcode.description: The shortcode at fault, when the problem is a shortcode. Empty otherwise.

missing.description: The parameters you still have to supply: ["confirm"] on "input_required".

note.description: One or two sentences for the user. On "input_required" it says what the switch does and how many findings there are.

processStatus.description: The status of the process after the call.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "activated", "paused", "unchanged" (already in that state), "input_required" (the mandate is there; read note and issues, ask the user and call again with confirm = true), "confirmation_required" (the account has not authorised an agent to do this: NOTHING happened, give the user the url), "invalid" (the checks failed; see issues), "not_found", "rate_limited", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

url.description: Path of the process in the asksteps studio, where the user does it themselves.

title: asksteps: switch a process on or pause it (needs the account's mandate)
